description:
Randall Lane, Forbes' Chief Content Officer, explains the vision behind the "250 Top Self-Made Americans" list and explores what the American Dream means in today's world.

Speaking from Philadelphia—the city chosen for its deep connection to America's founding ideals of innovation, opportunity, and upward mobility—Lane discusses how Forbes developed a unique methodology to identify truly self-made success stories. Rather than focusing solely on wealth or power, the list measures how far individuals have traveled from their starting points using a "self-made score," highlighting those who overcame significant obstacles to achieve extraordinary success.

author: Forbes
description:
What does it mean to start over—and how can adversity become the foundation for extraordinary success?

In this inspiring panel discussion, Joseph Neubauer, philanthropist and former business leader; Marcia G. Taylor; and Gary D. Tharaldson join moderator Jabari Young to share powerful lessons on resilience, leadership, entrepreneurship, and the courage to begin again.

Drawing from deeply personal experiences, the panelists discuss what "starting over" has meant throughout their careers—from immigrating to a new country and adapting to unfamiliar cultures, to rebuilding after personal tragedy, to continually launching new ventures driven by passion and determination.
